blocks.text: Blood capillaries tissues ko oxygen deti hain aur un se carbon dioxide le leti hain. Tissues mein CO₂ ka partial pressure khoon se zyada hota hai, is liye CO₂ tissues se khoon mein aa jati hai. Lungs mein ulta hota hai: alveoli mein CO₂ ka partial pressure khoon se kam hota hai. Khoon CO₂ ko tissues se lungs tak teen tareeqon se le jata hai.

Taqreeban 72% CO₂ khoon mein bicarbonate ions ki shakal mein jati hai. CO₂ RBCs mein ja kar enzyme carbonic anhydrase ki madad se pani se mil kar carbonic acid (H₂CO₃) banati hai. Carbonic acid toot kar hydrogen ions (H⁺) aur bicarbonate ions (HCO₃⁻) bana deta hai. Hydrogen ion oxyhaemoglobin se jud jata hai aur oxyhaemoglobin ki oxygen tissue ko mil jati hai. Bicarbonate ions RBCs se nikal kar plasma mein chale jate hain. Is mein ek transporter madad karta hai jo ek bicarbonate ion ke badle ek chloride ion (Cl⁻) andar laata hai; ise “chloride shift” ya “Hamburger phenomenon” kehte hain.

blocks.text_alt: CO₂ + H₂O ⇌ H₂CO₃ ⇌ H⁺ + HCO₃⁻ (carbonic anhydrase)

blocks.title: Acid-base balance
blocks.text: Carbonic acid ka banna khoon ka acid-base balance (tezabi aur alkaline hone ka tawazun) qaim rakhne mein aham hai, kyunke bicarbonate plasma ka sab se bada buffer (pH ko sambhalne wala) hai.
Taqreeban 20% CO₂ haemoglobin se jud kar jati hai. CO₂ haemoglobin ki globin (protein) chains se jud jati hai; is jode ko carbaminohaemoglobin kehte hain.

blocks.title: O₂ aur CO₂ muqabla kyun nahi karte
blocks.text: CO₂ haemoglobin ke protein hisse se judti hai aur O₂ haem ke iron se. Is liye dono haemoglobin par jagah ke liye aapas mein muqabla nahi karte.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne is ko “carboxyhaemoglobin” likha hai. Sahi naam carbaminohaemoglobin hai (CO₂ + haemoglobin ki globin chains). Carboxyhaemoglobin carbon monoxide (CO) aur haemoglobin ka jod hai, jo CO poisoning mein banta hai. Kitab yeh bhi kehti hai ke jab khoon mein CO₂ ka partial pressure tissues se zyada ho tab CO₂ haemoglobin se judti hai; yeh ulta hai. Tissues mein CO₂ ka partial pressure khoon se zyada hota hai, is liye CO₂ khoon mein aa kar globin chains se judti hai, jaisa pehle paragraph mein hai.
Jab CO₂ khoon mein aati hai to thodi si plasma ke pani mein ghul jati hai. Taqreeban 8% CO₂ isi tarah jati hai.

Khoon CO₂ ko in teeno shaklon mein lungs tak lata hai. Alveoli ki hawa mein CO₂ ka partial pressure (PCO₂) kam hota hai, is liye H₂CO₃ wapas H₂O aur CO₂ mein badal jata hai. CO₂ khoon se alveoli mein diffuse ho jati hai aur agli saans ke saath jism se nikal jati hai.

Daen, alveoli par: reactions ulti chalti hain aur carbon dioxide alveoli mein nikal jati hai.

Baen, tissues par: tissue cells ki carbon dioxide capillary ki deewar paar karti hai; kuch plasma mein ghulti hai, kuch red blood cell mein haemoglobin se jurti hai, aur kuch pani se mil kar (carbonic anhydrase) carbonic acid banati hai jo hydrogen ions (Hb se jurte hain) aur bicarbonate ions deta hai; bicarbonate RBC se nikalta hai aur chloride andar aata hai. Daen, alveoli par: reactions ulti chalti hain aur carbon dioxide alveoli mein nikal jati hai; bicarbonate RBC mein aata aur chloride nikalta hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Tissue par CO₂ ke teen raste: plasma mein ghulna (taqreeban 8%), haemoglobin se judna (taqreeban 20%) aur bicarbonate banna (taqreeban 72%). HCO₃⁻ bahar jata hai to barabari ke liye Cl⁻ andar aata hai; ise chloride shift kehte hain. Lungs mein sab ulta hota hai aur CO₂ saans ke saath nikal jati hai.

blocks.title: Carbon monoxide poisoning (CO ka zehar)
blocks.text: Lakdi, petrol, propane ya qudrati gas jaise eendhan poori tarah na jalein to CO gas banti hai. Band kamre mein gas heater raat bhar jalta rahe to CO kamre mein jama ho jati hai. Saans ke saath andar ja kar CO haemoglobin se oxygen ke muqable mein kahin zyada mazbooti se judti hai. Is se oxygen le jane ke liye haemoglobin kam bachta hai aur tissues ko oxygen nahi milti (hypoxia). Yahi CO poisoning hai. Alamaat: sar dard, chakkar, kamzori, matli (nausea), uljhan (confusion), saans phoolna, seene ka dard aur behoshi. Shadeed halat mein dimagh ko hamesha ka nuqsan aur maut bhi ho sakti hai.

blocks.prompt: Daudne wale ki taang ki muscles garam hain aur bohat CO₂ bana rahi hain. Kitab ke adad se batayein ke wahan khoon aaram ke muqable mein kitni zyada oxygen chhodta hai, aur kyun.
blocks.explanation: Aaram mein veins ke khoon mein oxygen ka partial pressure 40 mm Hg hai, haemoglobin 75% bhara rehta hai aur sirf 22% oxygen chhodta hai. Warzish mein muscles yeh pressure 20 mm Hg tak gira deti hain, saturation 35% reh jati hai aur 62% oxygen milti hai, yani taqreeban teen guna. Zyada CO₂ pH kam karti hai aur garmi temperature barhati hai; dono haemoglobin ki oxygen se pakad kam karte hain (Bohr effect), is liye oxygen wahin zyada chhoot-ti hai jahan zaroorat hai.

items: Oxygen: plasma sirf taqreeban 3 mL fi litre gholta hai, poora khoon taqreeban 200 mL le jata hai kyunke haemoglobin oxygen se judta hai. Arteries ka khoon 97% bhara (105 mm Hg); aaram mein veins ka 75% (40 mm Hg), yani 22% oxygen di gayi aur 75% zakheera; warzish mein 35% (20 mm Hg) aur 62% di gayi. Kam pH (Bohr effect) aur garmi haemoglobin se zyada oxygen chhudwate hain.

Carbon dioxide: 72% bicarbonate (carbonic anhydrase, chloride shift), 20% globin chains se judi (carbaminohaemoglobin), 8% plasma mein ghuli; lungs mein sab ulta. Bicarbonate plasma ka buffer hai. CO haemoglobin se mazbooti se jud kar hypoxia karti hai.
